blocks.prompt: 2 Solve the following trigonometric equation: \(2\cos x = -1\)
blocks.explanation:
Yeh \(\cos x\) mein ek seedhi (linear) equation hai. 2 se divide karein to basic equation \(\cos x = -\frac{1}{2}\) ban jati hai.
Find kya karna hai? Principal solutions aur general solution.
Rule: reference angle hamesha positive value \(\frac{1}{2}\) se; minus sign sirf quadrant batata hai.
Plan: divide, \(\alpha\) nikalo, quadrant II aur III mein angles likho, \(2n\pi\) jama karo.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(2\cos x = -1\).
Maloom karna: principal solutions aur general solution.
Tareeqa: pehle isay basic shakal \(\cos x = k\) mein laayenge, phir reference angle, quadrants aur period wale qadam.

Basic equation banayein
\[\cos x = -\dfrac{1}{2}\]
Kyun: dono taraf 2 se divide kiya taa ke \(\cos x\) akela reh jaye. Jab tak ratio akela na ho, table istemaal nahin kar sakte.

Reference angle
\[\cos\alpha = \dfrac{1}{2}\]
\[\alpha = \dfrac{\pi}{3}\]
Kyun: reference angle positive value \(\frac{1}{2}\) se nikalta hai, aur table mein \(\cos\frac{\pi}{3} = \frac{1}{2}\) hai.
Dhyan dein: \(x = \frac{\pi}{3}\) jawab nahin hai, kyunke \(\cos\frac{\pi}{3} = +\frac{1}{2}\). Yeh sirf hawala angle hai.

Quadrants
Cosine negative hai, is liye \(x\) quadrant II ya III mein hai.
Kyun: cosine unit circle par x-coordinate hai; yeh baayen (left) aadhe hisse mein, yani quadrant II aur III mein, negative hota hai.

Principal solutions
\[x = \pi - \dfrac{\pi}{3} = \dfrac{2\pi}{3}\]
\[x = \pi + \dfrac{\pi}{3} = \dfrac{4\pi}{3}\]
Kyun: quadrant II ka angle \(\pi - \alpha\) aur quadrant III ka angle \(\pi + \alpha\) hota hai. \(\pi = \frac{3\pi}{3}\) likh kar fractions jama ya minus kiye.

General solution
\(\cos x\) ka period \(2\pi\) hai:
\[\left\{\dfrac{2\pi}{3} + 2n\pi\right\}\]
\[\cup \left\{\dfrac{4\pi}{3} + 2n\pi\right\},\ n \in \mathbb{Z}\]
Kyun: har chakkar ke baad cosine wahi value dobara leta hai, is liye dono angles mein \(2n\pi\) jama kiya.

Tasdeeq
\[2\cos\dfrac{2\pi}{3} = 2\left(-\dfrac{1}{2}\right) = -1\]
\[2\cos\dfrac{4\pi}{3} = 2\left(-\dfrac{1}{2}\right) = -1\]
Kyun: dono angles asal equation mein daale aur dono taraf \(-1\) aaya, is liye jawab pakka hai.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text: Kitab mein Exercise 10.1 ke jawab chhape hue nahin hain. Is page ka har jawab hamara apna hai: qadam ba qadam hal kiya gaya, computer algebra system (sympy) se alag se check kiya gaya, aur ek solution book se bhi milaya gaya. Kitab ke examples ki tarah hum principal solutions \([0, 2\pi]\) mein aur general solution sets ke union ki shakal mein dete hain. Aap apna kaam yahan wale hal se mila kar dekh sakte hain.
